title: A green PR run is enough for the push skip; main runs only the suites the PR skipped (reading pending)
ruling: Owner 15:59 CST Nov 13, to the consultant, page item 769 pick a: a passing PR run is enough. Main runs only the suites the PR skipped. READING PENDING: the option text clashes with itself. "Main runs only the suites the PR skipped" means main still runs a large part of the suites (the narrowed-out ones), but the gain and lose lines say most merges skip most jobs and an untouched suite is not re-run on main until a later change touches it. The consultant asked the owner which he means (16:00 CST); the owner has not answered. Do not build until he does. Extends ruling push-skip-proven-tree (729 a, tree-equal skip) to a narrowed PR run.
quote: a (recommended): a passing PR run is enough. Main runs only the suites the PR skipped.
source: Owner chat with the consultant 15:59 CST Nov 13, relayed 16:00 CST; filed by triage. The option text was written by the consultant and carried by triage into item 769.
